lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits, organized into at least five distinct vertical columns between the pectoral and first dorsal fins.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae and circular blobs to form an orthogonal grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features showing a sharp vertical gradient (light superiorly, shadow inferiorly), extending from the post-cranial region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, low-contrast spots primarily localized toward the base and trailing edge of the first dorsal fin silhouette.
